method: Expert instruction and task-outcome review, performed by repairing worker; not independent model trials.

cases.input: Assume three supplied log streams exist; design an independent diagnosis plan.
cases.before_risk: Strong premise wording could be borrowed for live dispatch.
cases.repaired_judgment: Reason conditionally without claiming files were read or workers dispatched; no source demand for a pure design exercise.

cases.case: Live named file not found, independent docs available
cases.input: Repair a component using an absent required trace and compare existing manuals independently.
cases.before_risk: Only-source hold wording could stop unrelated useful work or treat stated existence as observed.
cases.repaired_judgment: Locate/read the trace; if unavailable hold only its dependent mutation. Continue the manual comparison with present inputs.

cases.input: Worker A owns src; B writes src/a.py concurrently.
cases.repaired_judgment: Reject overlap; sequence the actual dependency or choose genuinely disjoint ownership. The real validator now rejects the retained input.

cases.input: Cancel a planned chain before first output exists.
cases.before_risk: Stopping was treated as starting and required accepted input.
cases.repaired_judgment: Dispose both; do not create fictitious output evidence or infer unknown writes safe.

cases.input: Close a worker but consume its inspected accepted return.
cases.before_risk: The status transition erased accepted dependency meaning.
cases.repaired_judgment: Retain explicit accepted-output evidence and write readback when it wrote. Closed alone is insufficient.

cases.case: All workers finished, mission criterion fails
cases.input: Every responsibility is terminal but integrated verification failed.
cases.before_risk: VALID closed status could be presented as mission success.
cases.repaired_judgment: Report partial outcome and failed check. A declared accepted outcome with failed/missing checks rejects.

cases.input: Read-only incident diagnosis with concurrent external actors possible.
cases.before_risk: Example inferred unchanged production from no write permission.
cases.repaired_judgment: Report only observed dispatch/authority facts; unchanged production requires authoritative post-state evidence.

executable_correspondence: Runtime negative and positive tests cover the structured admission/lifecycle cases. Prose cases remain expert review with no reliability claim.
